source: OpesInsure Institutional Master Data Catalogue v1.0 — core domains (owner specification 2026-09-24). Seed order: countries → Cameroon geography → languages → currencies → organizations → legal entity types → persons/relationships → occupations → industries → activities.
notes: Seeded values are protected: deactivate only, never delete.
Lists ending with OTHER route free text to the review queue.
Domains also present in reference_2026/specialty_2026 are extended with distinct list codes only.
Cameroon arrondissements, communes and quarters are structure-only: no values are invented.
